system.notes: Light pistol. The improved Ares Squirt: the DMSO gel reservoir is now a removable clip, beside a second, parallel clip holding the chemical, and it carries twice the original's shots (20). Silent and recoilless compressed air; a hit delivers the compound through the skin, so damage is the compound's. Extra reservoir clips 10¥; the grip's CO₂ canister recharges for 50¥. May be drone-mounted; accepts no top-, barrel- or underbarrel accessories. DMSO lets a compound act on contact (Shadowtech p.89). Legality is not printed in the catalog. Corporate Security Handbook p.67.
